title: En la medida en que: establecer una condición o un grado

sections.content: En la medida en que (to the extent that, insofar as) links how much something happens to how much of a condition is met -- useful for describing gradual, proportional processes rather than simple yes/no outcomes. It's followed by a full clause. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: El Convenio 169 reconocía, en la medida en que los países lo ratificaran, el derecho a ser consultados previamente.
items.english: Convention 169 recognized, to the extent that countries ratified it, the right to be previously consulted.

items.spanish: Este convenio se convirtió, en la medida en que más países lo fueron ratificando, en la herramienta legal más citada.
items.english: This convention became, to the extent that more countries kept ratifying it, the most cited legal tool.

items.spanish: En la medida en que estos derechos territoriales se fueron reconociendo legalmente, también surgieron nuevos conflictos.
items.english: To the extent that these territorial rights were legally recognized, new conflicts also arose.

items.spanish: El proyecto solo podía avanzar en la medida en que la comunidad afectada diera su consentimiento previo.
items.english: The project could only move forward to the extent that the affected community gave its prior consent.

sections.content: En la medida en que describes a gradual, proportional relationship -- unlike siempre que or con tal de que, which set a simple yes/no condition, this one tracks degree: the more X happens, the more Y follows.
